sn12.66:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kurūsu viharati kammāsa dammaṃ nāma kurūnaṃ nigamo.
sn12.66:1.7: sammasatha no tumhe bhikkhave antaraṃ sammasanti.
sn12.66:1.8: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn12.66:1.9: ahaṃ kho bhante sammasāmi antaraṃ sammasanti.
sn12.66:1.10: yathākathaṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu sammasasi antaraṃ sammasanti.
sn12.66:1.12: yathā so bhikkhu byākāsi na so bhikkhu bhagavato cittaṃ ārādhesi.
sn12.66:2.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn12.66:2.2: etassa bhagavā kālo etassa sugata kālo
sn12.66:2.3: yaṃ bhagavā antaraṃ sammasaṃ bhāseyya bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantīti.
sn12.66:2.5: evaṃ bhanteti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
sn12.66:3.1: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammasamāno sammasati antaraṃ sammasaṃ
sn12.66:3.2: yaṃ kho idaṃ anekavidhaṃ nānappakārakaṃ dukkhaṃ loke uppajjati jarāmaraṇaṃ
sn12.66:3.3: idaṃ nu kho dukkhaṃ kiṃnidānaṃ kiṃsamudayaṃ kiṃjātikaṃ kiṃpabhavaṃ kismiṃ sati jarāmaraṇaṃ hotīti.
sn12.66:3.5: yaṃ kho idaṃ anekavidhaṃ nānappakārakaṃ dukkhaṃ loke uppajjati jarāmaraṇaṃ
sn12.66:3.6: idaṃ kho dukkhaṃ upadhinidānaṃ upadhisamudayaṃ upadhijātikaṃ upadhippabhavaṃ upadhismiṃ sati jarāmaraṇaṃ hoti upadhismiṃ asati jarāmaraṇaṃ na hotīti.
sn12.66:3.7: so jarāmaraṇañca pajānāti jarāmaraṇasamudayañca pajānāti jarāmaraṇanirodhañca pajānāti yā ca jarāmaraṇanirodhasāruppagāminī paṭipadā tañca pajānāti
sn12.66:3.9: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu sabbaso sammā dukkhakkhayāya paṭipanno jarāmaraṇanirodhāya.
sn12.66:4.2: upadhi panāyaṃ kiṃnidāno kiṃsamudayo kiṃjātiko kiṃpabhavo kiṃsmiṃ sati upadhi hoti kismiṃ asati upadhi na hotīti.
sn12.66:4.4: upadhi taṇhānidāno taṇhāsamudayo taṇhājātiko taṇhā pabhavo taṇhāya sati upadhi hoti taṇhāya asati upadhi na hotīti.
sn12.66:4.5: so upadhiñca pajānāti upadhisamudayañca pajānāti upadhi nirodhañca pajānāti yā ca upadhinirodhasāruppagāminī paṭipadā tañca jānāti tathā
sn12.66:4.7: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu sabbaso sammā dukkhakkhayāya paṭipanno upadhinirodhāya.
sn12.66:5.2: taṇhā panāyaṃ kattha uppajjamānā uppajjati kattha nivīsamānā nivīsatīti.
sn12.66:5.4: yaṃ kho loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ etthesā taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati ettha nivīsamānā nivīsati.
sn12.66:5.11: mano loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ etthesā taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati ettha nivīsamānā nivīsati.
sn12.66:6.1: ye hi keci bhikkhave atītamaddhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā yaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ taṃ niccato addakkhuṃ sukhato addakkhuṃ attato addakkhuṃ ārogyato addakkhuṃ khemato addakkhuṃ
sn12.66:6.3: ye taṇhaṃ vaḍḍhesuṃ te upadhiṃ vaḍḍhesuṃ
sn12.66:6.4: ye upadhiṃ vaḍḍhesuṃ te dukkhaṃ vaḍḍhesuṃ
sn12.66:6.5: ye dukkhaṃ vaḍḍhesuṃ te na parimucciṃsu jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi na parimucciṃsu dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
sn12.66:7.1: ye hi keci bhikkhave anāgatamaddhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā yaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ taṃ niccato dakkhissanti sukhato dakkhissanti attato dakkhissanti ārogyato dakkhissanti khemato dakkhissanti
sn12.66:7.3: ye taṇhaṃ vaḍḍhessanti te upadhiṃ vaḍḍhessanti
sn12.66:7.4: ye upadhiṃ vaḍḍhessanti te dukkhaṃ vaḍḍhessanti
sn12.66:7.5: ye dukkhaṃ vaḍḍhessanti te na parimuccissanti jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi na parimuccissanti dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
sn12.66:8.1: ye hi keci bhikkhave etarahi samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā yaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ taṃ niccato passanti sukhato passanti attato passanti ārogyato passanti khemato passanti
sn12.66:8.3: ye taṇhaṃ vaḍḍhenti te upadhiṃ vaḍḍhenti
sn12.66:8.4: ye upadhiṃ vaḍḍhenti te dukkhaṃ vaḍḍhenti
sn12.66:8.5: ye dukkhaṃ vaḍḍhenti te na parimuccanti jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi na parimuccanti dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
sn12.66:9.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave āpākanīyakaṃso vaṇṇasampanno gandha sampanno rasasampanno.
sn12.66:9.3: atha puriso āgaccheyya ghammābhitatto ghammapareto kilanto tasito pipāsito.
sn12.66:9.5: ayaṃ te ambho purisa āpāniyakaṃsaṃ vaṇṇasampanno gandhasampanno rasasampanno
sn12.66:9.8: pivato hi kho taṃ chādessati vaṇṇenapi gandhenapi rasenapi pivitvā ca pana tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigacchasi maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhanti.
sn12.66:9.9: so taṃ āpāniyakaṃsaṃ sahasā appaṭisaṅkhā piveyya na paṭinissajjeyya.
sn12.66:9.10: so tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigaccheyya maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ.
sn12.66:9.11: evameva kho bhikkhave ye hi keci atītamaddhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā yaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ …pe…
sn12.66:9.13: etarahi samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā yaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ taṃ niccato passanti sukhato passanti attato passanti ārogyato passanti khemato passanti te taṇhaṃ vaḍḍhenti.
sn12.66:9.14: ye taṇhaṃ vaḍḍhenti te upadhiṃ vaḍḍhenti
sn12.66:9.15: ye upadhiṃ vaḍḍhenti te dukkhaṃ vaḍḍhenti
sn12.66:9.16: ye dukkhaṃ vaḍḍhenti te na parimuccanti jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi na parimuccanti dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
sn12.66:10.1: ye ca kho keci bhikkhave atītamaddhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā yaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ taṃ aniccato addakkhuṃ dukkhato addakkhuṃ anattato addakkhuṃ rogato addakkhuṃ bhayato addakkhuṃ
sn12.66:10.3: ye taṇhaṃ pajahiṃsu te upadhiṃ pajahiṃsu
sn12.66:10.4: ye upadhiṃ pajahiṃsu te dukkhaṃ pajahiṃsu
sn12.66:10.5: ye dukkhaṃ pajahiṃsu te parimucciṃsu jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi parimucciṃsu dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
sn12.66:11.1: yepi hi keci bhikkhave anāgatamaddhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā yaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ taṃ aniccato dakkhissanti dukkhato dakkhissanti anattato dakkhissanti rogato dakkhissanti bhayato dakkhissanti
sn12.66:12.1: yepi hi keci bhikkhave etarahi samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā yaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ taṃ aniccato passanti dukkhato passanti anattato passanti rogato passanti bhayato passanti
sn12.66:12.3: ye taṇhaṃ pajahanti te upadhiṃ pajahanti
sn12.66:12.4: ye upadhiṃ pajahanti te dukkhaṃ pajahanti
sn12.66:12.5: ye dukkhaṃ pajahanti te parimuccanti jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi parimuccanti dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
sn12.66:13.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave āpāniyakaṃso vaṇṇasampanno gandha sampanno rasasampanno.
sn12.66:13.3: atha puriso āgaccheyya ghammābhitatto ghammapareto kilanto tasito pipāsito.
sn12.66:13.5: ayaṃ te ambho purisa āpāniyakaṃso vaṇṇasampanno gandhasampanno rasasampanno
sn12.66:13.8: pivato hi kho taṃ chādessati vaṇṇenapi gandhenapi rasenapi pivitvā ca pana tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigacchasi maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhanti.
sn12.66:13.9: atha kho bhikkhave tassa purisassa evamassa
sn12.66:13.10: sakkā kho me ayaṃ surā pipāsitā pānīyena vā vinetuṃ dadhimaṇḍakena vā vinetuṃ maṭṭhaloṇikāya vā vinetuṃ loṇasocirakena vā vinetuṃ na tvevāhantaṃ piveyyaṃ yaṃ mama assa dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyāti.
sn12.66:13.11: so taṃ āpāniyakaṃsaṃ paṭisaṅkhā na piveyya paṭinissajjeyya.
sn12.66:13.12: so tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā na nigaccheyya maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ.
sn12.66:13.13: evameva kho bhikkhave ye hi keci atītamaddhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā yaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ taṃ aniccato addakkhuṃ dukkhato addakkhuṃ anattato addakkhuṃ rogato addakkhuṃ bhayato addakkhuṃ
sn12.66:13.15: ye taṇhaṃ pajahiṃsu te upadhiṃ pajahiṃsu
sn12.66:13.16: ye upadhiṃ pajahiṃsu te dukkhaṃ pajahiṃsu
sn12.66:13.17: ye dukkhaṃ pajahiṃsu te parimucciṃsu jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi parimucciṃsu dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
sn12.66:14.2: etarahi samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā yaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ taṃ aniccato passanti dukkhato passanti anattato passanti rogato passanti bhayato passanti
sn12.66:14.4: ye taṇhaṃ pajahanti te upadhiṃ pajahanti
sn12.66:14.5: ye upadhiṃ pajahanti te dukkhaṃ pajahanti
sn12.66:14.6: ye dukkhaṃ pajahanti te parimuccanti jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi parimuccanti dukkhasmāti vadāmīti.
